summary: The registrant Nam Tai Property Inc. filed a Form 6-K reporting the results of its 2026 Annual Meeting of Shareholders held on June 15, 2026. Shareholders voted on the election of directors, with all six nominees elected. The filing discloses vote totals, including shares for, against, and abstained, but contains no transaction or special-situations event such as an acquisition, divestiture, or going-private proposal. The form is a routine current report on corporate governance matters.
